dropHint: Drop videos here, or click to choose
dropOnlyVideo: Only video files can be added
noVideosHint: Add the videos that need a title — hundreds at once is fine
thisVideoTitleHint: Leave empty to use the shared title
poolHint: Each video gets a random title from the pool
noJobs: No jobs yet. Add videos and a title under Create, then start the batch render
needPool: Please add at least one random title
renderStarted: Rendering started. You can leave this page — progress shows at the bottom and under Jobs
subtitle: Add titles to a batch of videos with a live preview, then render them all at once
useShared: Uses the shared title (type to override)
aiPlaceholder: Describe the product and selling points, e.g. S925 silver earrings, hypoallergenic, gift for her
aiEmpty: The AI returned no titles — try describing it differently
aiDone: Added {n} titles to the random pool
sharedPlaceholder: Type the title — short reads more natural; press Enter for a second line
sharedHint: All videos use this title; to change one, type in the box next to that video above
shrunk: The title is longer than the line limit, so it was shrunk to {p}% size
previewEmpty: Type a title to see it here instantly
previewHint: Changes show instantly with no rendering; use the buttons above to check the final look (takes a few seconds)
reused: Applied the titles and style from that record
presetNativeSummary: Looks like text typed in the TikTok app: small white medium-weight text with a soft shadow, next to the product — what most well-performing product ads use
titleTip: Top product ads: 3–8 words, casual like talking to a friend, ending with one emoji (✨🔥🤩); two short lines of the same size are fine
dragHint: Drag the title on the frame to place it.
jitterHint: Each video’s title moves up or down a little (about ±4%) so a batch doesn’t look identical
dialogDesc: Add a title to {n} videos as separate subtitled versions (originals kept)
dialogSharedHint: All these videos use this title
